name: local-app
description: 本地应用：Electron 壳 + Vite/React renderer，纯源码直连微内核与 SDK

scripts.build: vite build --config renderer/vite.config.ts && node --check src-main/main.mjs && node --check src-main/preload.cjs && node --check src-main/graph-host.mjs && node --check src-main/native-graph-host.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:renderer-boundary && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run diagnose -- validate && npm run verify:native-load && npm run build
